scope: Linux full attempt 2 realtime regression diagnosis and authorized fixture correction
regression: does not apply an unmounted realtime owner acknowledgement to its replacement draft
classification: Fixture did not await retired-owner stop cleanup; observed failure is not a stale acknowledgement mutating the replacement draft.
rootCause: Rerender with a new lease unmounts the old owner; its layout-effect cleanup starts thread/realtime/stop.
The replacement useOperations hook initially renders an empty array while the old stop is being durably created and later accepted/acknowledged in IndexedDB.
The test waits for the audio start button to be enabled before switching mode, but that enabled state can precede publication of the stop pending record.
The text mode change can flush the pending-operation render. The test then clicks a disabled text start button, so no second start is dispatched.
The stop later completes and the DOM becomes enabled again, but there is no automatic replay; findByText(active) therefore times out before the stale acknowledgement assertion.

sourceEvidence.observation: useOperations starts with [] and asynchronously refreshes durable records.
Mutation result resolves after create, RPC, accepted write, and acknowledgement cleanup.
Pending operations intentionally block new realtime start and disable its button.
Append acknowledgement checks current owner before changing text.
